αἰγίδα: αἰγίς — aegis, Zeus’s tasselled storm-shield; fem. acc. sg.
αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing, epithet of Zeus (meaning disputed, usually ’holding the αἰγίς’); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἷμ: αἷμα — blood; neut. acc. sg., elided (αἷμ’ = αἷμα)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’threw, dashed’ · also ’hit, struck’ a target (κατ’ ἀσπίδα … βάλε ’hit the shield’)
βάτην: βαίνω — go, walk; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήτην): ’the two went’
βήσετο: βαίνω — go, step, mount; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic mixed aor. (stem βησ- with thematic endings), unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήσατο): ’stepped onto’
βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in might’ · also periphrasis for a person, direct object: ’the might of Priam’ (= Priam himself) · also periphrasis for a person, acc. subject of an infinitive: ’the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles himself)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γαίας)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο)
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα)
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέμας: δέμας — bodily frame, build; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in build’
δέος: δέος — fear, dread; neut. nom. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαΐφρονος: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, or perhaps ’warlike’; sense disputed (from δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. gen. sg.
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
διομήδεος: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
δοιαὶ: δοιός — two, twofold; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic δύο)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰποῦσ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (εἰποῦσ’ = εἰποῦσα)
εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl. act. (augmented εὗρον = Attic ηὗρον)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θέτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put (for himself)’
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc./nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom./voc. pl. in abuse, with ἐλέγχεα: ’base disgraces’
κάλ: καλός — fair, fine, goodly; neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with τεύχεα: ’fine (armour)’ · also agreeing with σφυρά: ’fair (ankles)’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’fine (works)’
κάματος: κάματος — weariness, toil, fatigue; masc. nom. sg.
κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’)
κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, urge; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc. and inf.: ’I bid’
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’)
καμπύλα: καμπύλος — curved, bent; neut. acc. pl., with τόξα
κατέχευεν: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg., augmented, ν-movable
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’)
κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
κελαινεφὲς: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, black-clouded (epithet of Zeus); masc. voc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., of blood: ’dark-clouded’
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’)
κεχολώσεαι: χολόω — anger; mid. χολόομαι be angry (+ dat.); fut. perf. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic -ῃ): ’you will be angry’
κορυφῇ: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. dat. sg.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. nom. sg. (ἠΰτε κούρη ’like a girl’)
κούρους: κοῦρος — youth, young man; masc. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κόρους)
κρατὶ: κάρη (κράς) — head; neut. dat. sg. (stem κρατ-): ’on the head’
κρονίδην: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
κρονίωνα: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, epithet of Zeus; masc. acc. sg.
κυνέην: κυνέη — helmet, cap; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic κυνῆν)
κόσμον: κόσμος — order, due order, propriety; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
λάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize, take; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλάζετο)
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
λύσασ: λύω — loose, unyoke; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (λύσασ’ = λύσασα): ’having loosed’
μάλιστ: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, elided (μάλιστ’ = μάλιστα): ’most of all, especially’
μάστιξεν: μαστίζω — whip; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐμάστιξεν), ν-movable: ’whipped’
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’
μάχονται: μάχομαι — fight; pres. 3 pl. mid., + dat.: ’fight against’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great, big; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μεγαλήτορι: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. dat. sg.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὰψ: μάψ — idly, to no purpose, recklessly; adv.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νεφεληγερέταο: νεφεληγερέτης — cloud-gatherer, epithet of Zeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour unsettled); adj., masc. acc. sg.
οἶδε: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 sg. with present force: ’knows’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάνδαρος: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, son of Lycaon, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’)
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’)
πέλεν: πέλω — be, become; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was’
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’)
παρά: παρά — beside, by; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’)
πετέσθην: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented: ’the two flew’
πλεῖστοι: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, masc. nom. pl.: ’in the greatest numbers’
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολίων: πόλις — city; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεων)
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολυδειράδος: πολυδειράς — many-ridged (πολύς + δειράς ’ridge’); masc. gen. sg., epithet of Olympus
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
προκαλίζετο: προκαλίζομαι — challenge, call out (+ acc. of those challenged, + inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid.
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen.
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’
πωλέσκετο: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to go’
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
πύλαι: πύλη — gate; fem. nom. pl. (the plural is the usual form)
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
συμβάλλετον: συμβάλλω — throw together; of rivers, flow together, join; pres. 3 dual
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.: ’portent’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείρετο: τείρω — wear out, distress; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτείρετο): ’was worn down’
τεύχεσιν: τεῦχος — armour, gear; neut. dat. pl., ν-movable
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.: ’such a one’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
τυδεύς: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. nom. sg.
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’)
τόσον: τόσος — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’only so far’
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much, so greatly’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’so many’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’)
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg.
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable (cf. epic χερσί)
χρυσάμπυκας: χρυσάμπυξ — with golden frontlet (χρυσός + ἄμπυξ); masc. acc. pl., of horses
ἀέκοντε: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. nom. dual, uncontracted (= Attic ἄκοντε)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀκροτάτῃ: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superlative ἀκρότατος, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with κορυφῇ · also fem. dat. sg., with a noun understood: ’on the topmost (part)’ (ἐπ’ ἀκροτάτῃ ’on the very top’)
ἀλεξέμεναι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀλέξειν): ’to defend’
ἀλκή: ἀλκή — defence, strength to resist, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβρόσιος — immortal, divine; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (= Attic -αν), agreeing with νύκτα: ’immortal’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Argives!’
ἀργυρέοισιν: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἀργυροῖς), agreeing with ἐπισφυρίοις
ἀργυρότοξος: ἀργυρότοξος — of the silver bow; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Apollo
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀϋτῆς: ἀϋτή — shout, battle-cry; fem. gen. sg., with σχοίατο: ’(refrain) from shouting’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on a noun (’of the battle-cry’) and as object of ἀκούετο: ’heard the cry’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄτερ: ἄτερ — apart from, without; prep. + gen.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass, prevail; impf. 3 sg.: ’won, prevailed’
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικότα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. neut. acc. pl., + dat.: ’like’
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’struck, hit’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, station, halt; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’halted, stood’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕλκος: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; plpf. 3 pl., intransitive (= Attic εἱστήκεσαν): ’stood, were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ’he came’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’)
ἥβη: Ἥβη — Hebe, cupbearer of the gods, daughter of Zeus and Hera; fem. nom. sg.
ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥψατο: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἵκανον: ἱκάνω — come, arrive at; impf. 3 pl. act., epic (Attic ἀφικνέομαι): ’they came to’
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ἵσταμαι: ἵστημι — set up; mid. stand; pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I stand (before)’
ὀδύνῃσι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ὀδύναις)
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς)
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηϊδίως: ῥηΐδιος — easy; adv. ῥηϊδίως: ’easily, readily’, epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥοὰς: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. acc. pl.
